summary: Frontend-only web testing of P0 Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) and P1 empty-state chips on Research / Projects. Logged in as sam@funasia.net (super admin) at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Palette hotkey, sidebar Search button, backdrop click, Escape, query reset, fuzzy filter, all 14 nav items, all 9 quick actions, chats group, research threads group, projects group, message-a-person group all work as specified. P1 Project empty-state chips render (workspace had 0 folders), click opens the New folder dialog prefilled with name+description exactly as specced. P1 Research empty state could not be observed visually in this workspace (sam has 20 threads), but code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/Research.jsx confirms chips render only when threads.length===0 and each chip's onClick navigates to /my-ai?ask=<encoded prompt>; direct GET of /my-ai?ask=Hello%20test%20prompt confirms the personal-AI composer is prefilled with '@ai Hello test prompt'. No critical issues.

issues: Radix a11y console warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle`. The palette is portal'd via cmdk `Command` (not Radix Dialog) so this warning actually originates from the New Chat / New Group / New folder dialogs opened by quick actions, but noting because it appears in the palette-triggered flow. Non-blocking.

Optional: silence Radix DialogContent DialogTitle warning by adding a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden DialogTitle) to New Chat / New folder dialogs — accessibility only, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette.jsx cleanly implements event-based open (window 'tn:command-palette') + Ctrl/Cmd+K + Sidebar button — good decoupling.

loadedRef guard means chats/threads/folders/people are fetched once per mount. This is a good UX choice but means new data created in-session (e.g. a chat created via 'act-new-chat') will NOT appear in the palette groups until the page reloads. Non-blocking but worth noting.
Palette groups (chats/threads/folders/people) all suppress rendering when list is empty — good.
Fuzzy 'value' strings include useful synonyms (e.g. 'go to Home', 'message <name> <email>', 'chat <label>') so cmdk finds items by multiple keywords — good design.
Pre-existing (not this feature): ChatHeader.jsx has nested <button> inside <button> triggering React hydration warning — flagged for main agent (out of scope).
